instruction: Remove all songs from my Spotify song library and playlists that were released before 2021 year.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) with no answer. The song library and each playlist are modeled as 'containers' (type container with subtypes library/playlist; the library is the domain constant song-library) so that one spotify-show-song action covers both discovery paths: a song's release date can be looked up only after the container it sits in has been listed (show_song_library / show_playlist after show_playlist_library). Release-date knowledge is split into the static fact (released-before-2021 ?s) and the knowledge predicate (known-release-date ?s) produced by spotify.show_song. Removals require the token, the container to be shown, the song to be known old, and decrement a discrete countdown (pending-removals / succ) whose size equals the number of (container, pre-2021 song) links in :init (2 library links + 2 playlist links). Because removal actions can only remove old songs that are still contained and nothing can be added, (pending-removals n0) holds exactly when every pre-2021 song has been removed from the library and from all playlists, which is the goal and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task; n0 is a domain constant so the goal can be stated in the domain without referring to problem objects. The concrete library/playlist contents are unknown a priori, so the problem contains a representative instance; at runtime the agent must call show_song on every library and playlist song (paginating show_song_library and show_playlist_library) to learn release dates, while the planner only inspects the songs that turn out to be old. A song appearing in both the library and a playlist needs only one show_song call but one removal per link.
